ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer (Multifaction Fork)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Multiplayer Team (fork by Gesprosio)
ModMetaData.description: Unofficial fork of the RimWorld Multiplayer mod focused on multifaction play: quests and choices routed to the right player, custom and fluid ideoligions at faction creation, faction retirement, and several desync and save-corruption fixes.\n Replaces the official Multiplayer mod - do not enable both. Host and all clients must run this exact same build.\n Important: place right below Core and expansions in the mod list! Requires RimWorld >= 1.6.4491\n Based on rwmt/Multiplayer (MIT) by the RimWorld Multiplayer Team, on top of PR #961 by CormacOConnor72. Developed in pair-programming with AI (Claude); every fix is documented and play-tested.\n Fork & changelog - https://github.com/Disprosio-dot/Multiplayer Upstream FAQ - https://hackmd.io/@rimworldmultiplayer/docs/ Discord - https://discord.gg/S4bxXpv
